Name: (FS)Rustic Cloths CocumiT
Author: Tcocumi
Description:
[size=4]Dresses come in long and short skirts, they are made of rustic fabrics and contain vibrant flowers, will you like this style?

This mod runs on [/size][color=#ff0000][b]FashionSense[/b][/color][size=4].[/size]

[size=4]How to use: Download and install [/size][b][color=#ff0000]FashionSense[/color] [/b][size=4]and[/size][color=#ff0000][b](FS) Rustic Cloths CocumiT[/b][/color][size=4], enter the game, go to the shop to buy a handheld mirror, and use it to change clothes.[/size]
